name: slushpile
description: An adversarial job search for Codex that gets better as it goes. Score fit against the realistic applicant pool, build the resume and cover letter, review them the way a fatigued recruiter would, then keep what the review finds in your profile.

interface.shortDescription: Get rejected by seven agents before a recruiter does it
interface.longDescription: Onboard once to build a profile and a preferences file. Then search a careers board, score each role against the realistic applicant pool instead of against the keywords, build a resume and cover letter from your own evidence, and run a seven-agent adversarial review that returns a verdict per application channel, not one feel-good yes.
defaultPrompt: Set up slushpile in this directory.
Search the Anthropic careers board for roles that fit my profile.
Run an adversarial review on this resume and cover letter.
